summaries.Romania: Romania faces political uncertainty as President Nicușor Dan prepares to designate a new premier, while controversies over SPP chief Lucian Pahonțu's past and the ANI law's impact on Timișoara mayor Dominic Fritz dominate governance discussions. Key energy infrastructure projects are advancing through PNRR funding despite delays in coal plant closures.
summaries.Healthcare: FDA approves Roivant's JAK inhibitor for rare autoimmune disease dermatomyositis while healthcare systems tackle affordability challenges through new payment models and AI integration. Significant legal settlements continue reshaping Medicare and pharmacy benefit manager practices.
summaries.Tech: Apple announces new M6 Mac mini and M5 Ultra Mac Studio ahead of September 9 iPhone event, while raising Apple TV subscription prices for the fourth time in four years. Major AI policy wins include Anthropic's court victory against Trump administration blacklisting and self-improving AI breakthroughs.

items.line: Nicușor Dan's promulgation of the ANI law forces Dominic Fritz to lose his mayoral mandate, highlighting governance tensions around conflict-of-interest enforcement.

items.title: Nicușor Dan ar urma să desemneze un premier săptămâna viitoare. Variantă: Guvern PSD, condus de un independent (surse)
items.snippet: România ar putea avea un nou premier desemnat în mai puțin de o săptămână. Președintele Nicușor Dan îi va chema de la 1 septembrie pe liderii partidelor la noi consultări, iar potrivit surselor Digi24 varianta preferată de șeful statului ar fi un Guvern cu miniștri politici, dar cu premier independe
items.line: Romania's political transition accelerates with Dan set to designate a new premier within days, with sources indicating preference for a PSD government led by an independent.

items.title: STAT+: FDA approves Roivant therapy for rare autoimmune disease
items.snippet: The FDA approved a new medicine from Roivant and its subsidiary Priovant for the treatment of dermatomyositis, a rare autoimmune disease.
items.line: FDA approval of Roivant's Lisraya for dermatomyositis marks a breakthrough in rare autoimmune disease treatment with potential for additional indications.

items.title: Apple will launch 15+ new products this fall, here’s what’s coming
items.snippet: Apple has a packed lineup of products launching this fall, including new iPhones, Macs, iPads, and more. Here’s every new Apple product rumored to arrive starting September 9.
items.line: Apple's September 9 event will introduce 15+ products including foldable iPhone, iPhone 18 Pro, and Apple Watch Series 12, marking the year's biggest product rollout.

items.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
items.snippet: A federal judge ruled the Trump administration illegally labeled Anthropic a supply-chain risk, handing the AI company a victory as its second Pentagon lawsuit continues in Washington.
items.line: Federal judge rules Trump administration's Pentagon blacklisting of Anthropic illegal and unconstitutional, handing major AI safety company a critical legal victory.

items.line: Romania's Ministry of Energy has deployed €233M through PNRR with two modernized thermal plants now connected to the national grid, though lignite closure deadlines are being extended.

items.title: Eli Lilly study aims to bolster case for long-term Zepbound benefits
items.snippet: As Medicare's GLP-1 Bridge program gets underway in earnest and questions remain about the long-term use of these drugs, Eli Lilly is offering a new look at how older adults fare on its medication, Zepbound.
items.line: Eli Lilly's GLP-1 obesity drug study addresses growing questions about long-term safety and efficacy as Medicare expands access through its Bridge program.

items.title: The Villages Health reaches $541M False Claims Act settlement with DOJ
items.snippet: The Villages Health System has agreed to a $541.5 million settlement to resolve allegations that it submitted false diagnosis codes to secure higher payouts in Medicare Advantage.
items.line: Villages Health settles $541M False Claims Act case over diagnosis code billing fraud, signaling continued DOJ enforcement against Medicare Advantage schemes.

items.title: Sword Health to acquire Headspace in all-cash deal
items.snippet: The virtual physical therapy and mental health platforms are targeting a September close, per a regulatory filing. A price tag was not disclosed, but is being reported to land between $200 million and $300 million.
items.line: Sword Health acquires Headspace in all-cash deal valued at $200-300M, consolidating virtual physical therapy and mental health platforms.

items.title: Apple TV is raising its subscription prices again
items.snippet: Now, Apple TV subscriptions will cost $14.99 per month, up from its previous price of $12.99 per month.
items.line: Apple TV subscription price increases to $14.99/month from $12.99, the fourth hike in four years, reflecting streaming service's aggressive pricing strategy.

items.title: Report: Nvidia to acquire AI model repository Hugging Face for $13 billion
items.snippet: Nvidia is nabbing critical infrastructure for open models as interest grows.
items.line: Nvidia reportedly acquiring Hugging Face for $13B to secure open-source AI infrastructure as competition intensifies in model deployment and governance.

items.title: An Anthropic researcher just gave us a peek at self-improving AI
items.snippet: Given 10 benchmarks for specific misaligned behaviors, the automated systems were able to improve performance on every single one without degrading overall performance.
items.line: Anthropic researcher demonstrates self-improving AI systems that fix misaligned behaviors across benchmarks without degrading overall performance.
